technical_and_design_decisions: Extend existing Spring Cloud Data Flow deployment property parsing logic to support the {{count}} placeholder syntax, which resolves to the specified number of identical module instances sharing the same environment variables, without modifying core Spring Framework deployment property handling.

Use GitHub's native GitHub Pages feature with gh_pages branches for documentation hosting, configure branch protection rules to enforce PR reviews and CI checks before merging documentation changes, and integrate with existing GitHub Actions CI pipelines for auto-deployment.

Align Kafka binder fixes with the latest Spring for Apache Kafka compatibility matrix for Spring Cloud Stream 4.0+, use Testcontainers for integration testing against a real Kafka broker to ensure fixes work with operational broker versions 2.8+.

Use AsciiDoc format for all reference documentation to match existing Spring project documentation standards, and use Mermaid syntax for architecture diagrams to ensure compatibility with the project's documentation rendering pipeline.

Integrate RxJava 3 support into Spring Cloud Stream processor modules, as RxJava 3 is compatible with Java 17+ required by Spring Framework 6.0, and provide a sample application to demonstrate usage for module authors.
Embed the static shell server banner as a classpath resource in the shell server module, and add a startup hook that prints the banner to the console before the server starts listening for requests.

Structure the Cloud Foundry deployment guide as a step-by-step tutorial with prerequisites, configuration steps, and troubleshooting sections, aligned with current Spring Cloud Data Flow 2.x deployment best practices for Cloud Foundry v8+.
assumptions: The {{count}} placeholder in U1 is limited to a maximum value of 100 for this increment, and no additional custom placeholder syntax support is required beyond the specified {{count}} syntax.
The {{gh_pages}} branch setup for both the s-c-d and s-c-s-m repositories does not require custom domain configuration or advanced Jekyll theme customization for this increment.
The Kafka binder fix in U3 targets Kafka broker versions 2.8 and above, which are the currently supported versions for the Spring Cloud Data Flow 2.x release line.
The RxJava processor module integration in U6 uses RxJava 3, which is compatible with Spring Cloud Stream 4.0 and Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
The Concourse CI study in U5 will produce a 2-page internal summary document of relevant features, and no full CI pipeline implementation for s-c-d is required for this increment.
The shell server banner in U7 is a static text banner with no dynamic runtime content generation requirements.
The Cloud Foundry deployment documentation in U8 covers Cloud Foundry version 8 and above, which is the currently supported version for Spring Cloud Data Flow 2.x.

activities.activity_name: Analyze existing deployment property parsing logic
activities.activity_description: Review current Spring Cloud Data Flow deployment property parsing code to identify extension points for supporting the {{count}} placeholder syntax for module instance count.
Develop logic to resolve the {{count}} placeholder to the specified number of identical module instances, each configured with the same shared environment variables.
Write unit tests covering edge cases for {{count}} resolution including count=0, count=1, count=100, and invalid non-numeric count values.
Update existing deployment property documentation to include usage examples and syntax rules for the {{count}} placeholder.

activities.activity_description: Create and configure the gh_pages branch for the Spring Cloud Data Flow repository, enable GitHub Pages hosting, and set up initial documentation folder structure.

activities.activity_name: Configure gh_pages branch for s-c-s-m repository
activities.activity_description: Create and configure the gh_pages branch for the Spring Cloud Stream Modules repository, enable GitHub Pages hosting, and set up initial documentation folder structure.
Set up branch protection rules for both gh_pages branches to require PR approvals and passing CI checks before merging documentation changes.

activities.activity_description: Modify existing GitHub Actions CI pipelines for both repositories to automatically build and deploy documentation to the gh_pages branch on PR merge to main.

Develop and implement fixes for identified Kafka binder configuration and binding logic issues to enable successful binding to operational Kafka brokers.
Create integration tests using Testcontainers to validate Kafka binder functionality against a real Kafka broker, covering producer, consumer, and partitioned consumer use cases.
Update Kafka binder documentation to include configuration requirements and best practices for binding to operational Kafka brokers.
Collect existing 1.x and 2.x architecture design documents, deployment guides, and migration notes to use as source material for reference documentation.
Draft reference documentation sections covering core architecture differences, deployment topology differences, and configuration differences between Spring Cloud Data Flow 1.x and 2.x.
Design and implement Mermaid syntax architecture diagrams for 1.x and 2.x deployment topologies to include in the reference documentation.
Review, finalize, and publish the s-c-d architecture reference documentation to the project's public documentation site.
